name: UPTD PPA Kota Banjarbaru (Perlindungan Perempuan & Anak) – under Dinas P3APMP2KB Kota Banjarbaru
address: Dinas office: Jl. Taman Gembira Barat RT.05/RW.01 (new office opened 10 Jan 2024). UPTD PPA's own address is not published.
kelurahan: conflicting sources: Guntung Paikat (KIM Banjarbaru) vs Komet (OSM street)
coord_method: none for the building. Exa pin 'DP3APPKB' (-3.427683, 114.851946, Mentaos) is NOT used because it doesn't match the 2024 office address and is probably the old office.

approx_coords.method: OSM Nominatim street-level geocode (street centroid, NOT building) for Jl. Taman Gembira Barat

services: menerima pengaduan kekerasan terhadap perempuan & anak
rujukan rumah aman (provincial programme via UPTD kab/kota)
cost: not stated in any Banjarbaru source (government service, so presumably free; unverified)
eligibility: women and children who are victims of violence, plus people reporting such cases
complaint_method: national SAPA 129 also routes cases to the local UPTD
local_notes: Caseload: 81 cases in 2024, 63 in 2023 (ANTARA, Feb 2025). Head of dinas Erma Epiyana; head of UPTD PPA Lia Rahmawati (Feb 2025). In Oct 2024 it handled psychological assessment of a viral KDRT victim. Rumah aman locations are deliberately not published.
